Review the exact committed Testcenter rewrite change ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271..5308c84ee3fab34754ea71a2917be9ae19b19923. Your dimension is code-review. Find concrete correctness, regression, lifecycle, rendering/control and test-contract defects introduced by the patch. Verify identity precision, profile selection, auth transitions and asynchronous work.
Inspect the actual diff and source. The worktree is pinned to HEAD. Original is read-only at /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/en/work/testcenter-original (eedae41840cbe90e5547c0211da818bdf620f5aa). Preserve stronger tenant/workspace/group boundaries and existing browser, deadline, privacy and 470kB budget gates.
Establish scope from the actual diff, checked-in documentation and commit-matched evidence. Incremental checks do not prove whole-project parity. Verify whether older open handoff issues remain open; report concrete introduced defects rather than merely restating unfinished project scope.
Historical validation receipts: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/outputs/testcenter-native-monitor-ui-20261028.json and /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/native-monitor-ui-cache-env-proof/result.json. Match each claim to its actual commit, tree, scenario and result. Historical success cannot qualify a newer HEAD; historical failures may have been fixed. Do not claim current CI success without current matching evidence.
Return requested JSON only. Findings need a tracked repository-relative path, exact current line, evidence and remedy. Use request_changes for any unresolved substantive defect, inconclusive if review could not complete, unknown for missing signal evidence. Explain what you actually verified and the remaining limits.
I’ll inspect the committed diff, repository guidance, and the supplied validation receipts, then trace the affected behavior against the current source and Original checkout.

The patch adds a native monitor frontend and retains polling rather than WebSocket transport. I’m tracing how its access scope, route selection, and pending requests interact, and checking which supplied results actually match this commit.

{
  "role": "code-review",
  "head": "5308c84ee3fab34754ea71a2917be9ae19b19923",
  "base": "ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271",
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "signal": "fail",
  "summary": "The native monitor has unresolved finish-all recovery and authentication lifecycle defects. The supplied validation receipts do not establish CI success for this commit.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/group-monitor/test-session-manager/test-session-manager.service.ts",
      "line": 367,
      "title": "Retrying finish-all can leave connected tests unterminated",
      "evidence": "Finish-all first locks the captured tests, then sends terminate after a delay. If the terminate request fails, the UI reports failure, but the locks have already committed. On retry, the fresh snapshot excludes every locked test from both lockIds and terminateIds, so the retry can succeed and navigate away without terminating those still-connected tests. The same gap occurs if the operation is interrupted after locking.",
      "recommendation": "Make the operation recoverable across partial completion: retain or reconstruct the exact authorized termination targets after locking, and do not report completion until their termination requests succeed. Add coverage for a failed or interrupted terminate followed by retry."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/native-monitor-entry.component.ts",
      "line": 54,
      "title": "Bind logout confirmation to the session that opened it",
      "evidence": "The dialog subscription survives component destruction and calls session.logout() on whichever access is current when it closes. If the original access is cleared or the user navigates away and signs in again while the confirmation remains open, confirming the old dialog logs out the new session and navigates back to the monitor.",
      "recommendation": "Capture the access identity when opening the dialog, cancel and close it when that access or component is retired, and verify the identity before logging out or navigating."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "rewrite-app/apps/web/src/app/native-monitor/native-monitor-entry.component.ts",
      "line": 48,
      "title": "Cancel pending login navigation when the entry view is retired",
      "evidence": "submit awaits an unscoped login and then opens the sole claim. ngOnDestroy only unsubscribes from backend problems, so a delayed login or proof-of-work result can establish access and navigate back to the monitor after the user has left the entry view.",
      "recommendation": "Tie login and its continuation to the entry view's lifetime; cancel or invalidate pending authentication on destruction and avoid applying or navigating from a retired attempt."
    }
  ],
  "verified": [
    "Checked the actual base-to-head diff, current HEAD and tree, native monitor routes, session and request scopes, profile selection, signed-int64 serialization, polling, Booklet caching, controls, and relevant lifecycle tests against current source.",
    "Compared the finish-all and login behavior with the named read-only Original checkout and inspected the checked-in monitor scope and qualification limits.",
    "The supplied receipt reports completed base CI at ad92a086, historical published CI failures at 13b553, and later local evidence at fe4e882; none is a complete CI result for 5308c84. The cache-environment proof names 5d9ba6c as its pre-fix head.",
    "Earlier reported Goto context capture, slow Booklet enrichment, profile cancellation and timer input issues have corresponding changes in current source; their historical failures alone are not treated as current findings."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "No current commit-matched CI or complete browser qualification was supplied, and broad suites were not rerun. Whole-project, visual and native participant transport parity remain unproven.",
    "Findings are based on source and control-flow inspection; the partial finish and stale authentication scenarios were not reproduced in a browser during this review.",
    "The repository Brain brief could not run because its lock directory could not be created in the read-only environment; direct source and documentation inspection was used instead."
  ]
}
